topThreats.title: Attackers Chain Three Ivanti Connect Secure Flaws to Gain Unauthenticated Root Access
topThreats.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added two security flaws impacting Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following active exploitation in the wild. The vulnerabilities are listed below - CVE-20
topThreats.remediation: Board/Executive: Validate NIST CSF 2.0 / NERC CIP / 10 CFR 73.54 boundary isolation. Task Execution: Enforce unidirectional or zero-trust Purdue Model conduits, rotate boundary credentials, and monitor engineering workstation logs.

topThreats.title: CISA Adds Two Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
topThreats.summary: CISA has added two new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog, based on evidence of active exploitation.
